teach_overlay.scale: your bitter taste receptors are more than a thousand times more sensitive than your sweet receptors — because missing a spoonful of sugar only costs you a few calories, whereas swallowing a single mouthful of bitter plant poison could cost you your life

teach_overlay.scale: your cells replace every worn-out taste bud receptor every ten to fourteen days — which is why scalding your tongue on hot soup only dulls your taste for a few days before a brand-new set of taste buds grows back
